example_summary: Parents of Amit receiving ₹ 5 lacs compensation from Government of Chattisgarh following Dantewada bus bomb blast.
source_provision:
### Statutory Summary: Section 10(10BC)

| Statutory Section | Source of Compensation | Eligible Recipient | Tax Treatment |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Section 10(10BC)** | Central Govt / State Govt / Local Authority | Individual or Legal Heir | **100% Exempt** from Income Tax |


**Key Statutory Conditions & Definitions:**

*   **Meaning of Disaster**: As defined under Section 2(d) of the Disaster Management Act, 2005, it refers to a catastrophe, mishap, calamity, or grave occurrence arising from natural or manmade causes, or by accident/negligence, resulting in substantial loss of life or human suffering beyond the coping capacity of the affected community.
*   **Eligible Payers**: Exemption applies exclusively to compensation granted by the Central Government, State Government, or any Local Authority.
*   **Eligible Beneficiaries**: Compensation can be received either by the victim individual directly or by their legal heirs in case of death.


> [!WARNING] Statutory Proviso Restriction: Exemption under Section 10(10BC) shall NOT be available to the extent of any amount that has been allowed as a deduction under the Income-tax Act on account of any loss or damage caused by such disaster.

director.justification: The scenario evaluates whether ₹ 5 lacs compensation paid by the Chattisgarh Government to the parents of bomb blast victim Amit meets all statutory criteria under Section 10(10BC) to qualify for complete income tax exemption.
director.visual_metaphor: A glowing statutory checklist gate confirming eligibility criteria before granting full tax exemption shield.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Introduce the fact scenario of Amit's parents receiving ₹ 5 lacs compensation from Chattisgarh Government due to Dantewada bomb blast.
Define Section 10(10BC) and the meaning of disaster under Section 2(d) of the Disaster Management Act 2005.
Validate statutory eligibility conditions for exemption: Government source, Disaster definition, and Legal heir recipient.
Explain the statutory proviso restriction regarding pre-claimed tax deductions.
Conclude that the ₹ 5 lacs received by Amit's parents is fully exempt under Section 10(10BC).
